Name: Wallpaper Picker
Author: nunuva
Description:
[size=6]Wallpaper Picker
[/size][size=3]Instantly get a copy of any wallpaper or flooring you see. No more searching through catalogues, just point at a surface and press a key to add it to your inventory.

[/size][u][size=3]This mod bypasses the in-game cost, so it can be considered a cheat if you haven't purchased the catalogues.[/size]
[/u]
[size=5]How to Use[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Point your cursor at any wallpaper or flooring.[/size]
[*][size=3]Press the [u][b]Middle Mouse Button[/b]([/u]Scroll Wheel Button) (or your configured key).[/size]
[*][size=3]The item will be added to your inventory.[/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Configuration
[/size][size=3]To change the key, edit the [u]config.json[/u] file, which is created in the [u]Mods/WallpaperPicker[/u] folder after you run the game once.
Simply change the [b]GrabKey [/b]value to your desired key. A list of valid keys can be found on the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings]Stardew Valley Wiki[/url].[/size]
